rationale: graph::parse first collects node declarations and deferred slot assignments, which permits forward references and skips blank/comment lines. identifier uses Unicode alphabetic/alphanumeric characters with underscore support; args respects quoted commas/escapes and label delegates quoted strings to JSON decoding. Constructor matches enforce the stated arities and at most one variable store, prepopulate array slots, and distinguish lease/leased and shlease/shared aliases from showned. Tests verify Unicode labels, quoted comma/HTML escaping, variables as grouped slots, array empties, and equal diagrams for canonical/alias spellings despite retained distinct source descriptions.
limitations: These are diagram facts only; the parser neither executes machine operations nor adds borrow/primitive/array semantics to the Given or Shared language layers.
